coverage.origin_classification: Frontend: source driver functions outside runtime.c. CRT: runtime.c overrides plus matched LIBC.LIB/SETARGV code. Imports: import thunks. Includes shared text data; categories are disjoint. This describes the reconstruction origins, not a complete original linker map.
coverage.metric: Union of accepted original code extents, shared text data, CRT and import thunks, clipped to code-section VirtualSize; not branch coverage.

recovered_tail.explanation: Both original and native finish broken_initializer, implicit_call and recovered_tail in order; equal symbol kind/flags/index/attributes and both full flag words, then active function symbol clears at each caller return.

flag_repairs.scope: All accepted application instructions accessing either word; per-function union of tested/cleared/set/toggled/copied bits. This does not establish branch coverage or execution order.
flag_repairs.new_true_mask_path: final-tag-flags original/native observations include local declarations with scanner_flags0x80000 set.
flag_repairs.historical_receipts: Earlier matching-output receipts retained, insufficient for internal word identity; current correction proof is explicit.
